arc-s4d-tam-P01.description: Comparison of autonomous navigation with SLAM methods on UAV datasets, including ablations and validation under near-field conditions. The planned outputs are a navigation model and a reproducible benchmark.
arc-s4d-tam-P01.nextStep: Freeze the benchmark protocol and complete comparisons with baseline navigation methods.

arc-rgbt-P01.description: Study of the effects of resolution and optical geometry on object detection. The planned outputs are observability limits and a set of experiments.
arc-rgbt-P01.nextStep: Confirm data sources with reference annotations and run the first resolution experiment.

arc-rgbt-P02.description: Comparison of RGB and thermal image fusion with synchronisation and scene changes. The planned output is an evaluated modality integration method.
arc-rgbt-P02.nextStep: Finalise the RGB–LWIR pairing protocol and prepare a reliably synchronised dataset.

arc-dera-hri-P01.description: Planned assessment of the factor structure, reliability and validity of a questionnaire administered after robot interaction. The intended output is a validated measurement instrument.
arc-dera-hri-P01.nextStep: Prepare the pilot study protocol and psychometric analysis plan before recruitment.

arc-rvi-P01.description: Comparison of robotic inspection methods in controlled simulation scenarios. The planned outputs are a reproducible benchmark and quality metrics.
arc-rvi-P01.nextStep: Run a reproducible benchmark with a frozen scene configuration and collect initial results.

arc-rgbt-P03.description: Measurements of latency, memory and energy consumption on an edge device. The planned outputs are a performance profile and trade-off analysis.
arc-rgbt-P03.nextStep: Select a physical computing platform and start latency and memory measurements.

arc-rvi-P02.description: Tests of locating a specified object among similar items. The planned outputs are a localisation algorithm and a set of test scenes.
arc-rvi-P02.nextStep: Define the objects, test scenes and localisation metrics.

arc-rvi-P03.description: Camera pose and route planning that accounts for the humanoid's entire body. The planned output is a planner for safe observation poses.
arc-rvi-P03.nextStep: Freeze the kinematic model and the camera pose planner constraints.

arc-affective-P01.description: Assessment of affect recognition from a limited number of EEG channels across datasets. The planned outputs are representations and a robustness benchmark.
arc-affective-P01.nextStep: Select two compatible public EEG datasets and define a cross-montage transfer protocol.

arc-rvi-P04.description: Active selection of views with incomplete knowledge of object geometry. The planned output is a coverage and uncertainty assessment procedure.
arc-rvi-P04.nextStep: Formalise object observation coverage and uncertainty metrics.

arc-affective-P02.description: Study of signal fusion with missing modalities and uncertain measurements. The planned output is a fusion algorithm with calibration assessment.
arc-affective-P02.nextStep: Select a licensed multimodal dataset and plan missing-modality scenarios.

arc-rgbt-P04.description: Tests of sensor degradation and failure with controlled detection error risk. The planned outputs are failure detection and selective prediction mechanisms.
arc-rgbt-P04.nextStep: Define realistic RGB/LWIR failure scenarios and a false alarm budget.

arc-rvi-P05.description: Measurement of the effects of gait and camera pose on image repeatability. The planned outputs are acquisition recommendations and error metrics.
arc-rvi-P05.nextStep: Prepare a repeated-measurement protocol for camera pose during locomotion.

arc-rgbt-P05.description: Assessment of model transfer between RGB and thermal cameras. The planned output is a cross-device validation protocol.
arc-rgbt-P05.nextStep: Obtain data from an independent physical sensor for cross-device validation.

arc-rvi-P06.description: Selection and repetition of views based on sharpness, exposure and completeness. The planned output is a closed-loop image quality controller.
arc-rvi-P06.nextStep: Define measurable thresholds for image sharpness, exposure and completeness.

arc-affective-P03.description: Analysis of signal and cognitive workload changes between sessions. The planned outputs are an adaptive individual model and a validation protocol.
arc-affective-P03.nextStep: Prepare a repeated-session schedule and a signal drift assessment procedure.

arc-affective-P04.description: Tests of facial expression analysis on a local device without storing raw recordings. The planned output is a model evaluated for privacy and quality.
arc-affective-P04.nextStep: Freeze the on-device test scenario without recording retention.

arc-rgbt-P06.description: Study of tracking stability during occlusions and temporary modality loss. The planned output is a method for associating identities between frames.
arc-rgbt-P06.nextStep: Obtain RGB–LWIR sequences with object identity labels over time.

arc-affective-P05.description: Use of hand kinematics to assess movement quality and task demand. The planned outputs are a model and a set of movement features.
arc-affective-P05.nextStep: Define movement tasks and measurable hand kinematic features.

arc-rvi-P07.description: Comparison of simulated and real scenarios, with analysis of domain differences. The planned outputs are a transfer procedure and a limitations report.
arc-rvi-P07.nextStep: Identify a legally usable, comparable set of real images for sim-to-real analysis.

arc-affective-P06.description: Comparison of difficulty adaptation controlled by model uncertainty. The planned outputs are a personalisation strategy and experimental validation.
arc-affective-P06.nextStep: Prepare an N-of-1 experiment comparing difficulty adaptation rules.

arc-rvi-P08.description: Validation of humanoid object documentation in repeatable field tasks. The planned outputs are an experimental protocol and utility metrics.
arc-rvi-P08.nextStep: Define field validation criteria and the available hardware scope.

arc-affective-P07.description: Integration of gaze direction and hand motion for safe robot control. The planned outputs are a demonstrator and fail-safe mechanism tests.
arc-affective-P07.nextStep: Build a safe ROS 2/Gazebo scenario with emergency-stop tests.

arc-affective-P08.description: Benchmarks of robust CPU/GPU signal processing under real-time constraints. The planned outputs are an inference architecture and measurements.
arc-affective-P08.nextStep: Define identical CPU/GPU test workloads and failure metrics.

arc-rgbt-P07.description: Optional study of sensor and resolution selection under an energy budget. The intended output would be an energy-saving policy; work is on hold.
arc-rgbt-P07.nextStep: HOLD: decide whether to activate after completing the P03 performance measurements.

arc-rgbt-P08.description: Optional analysis of spatiotemporal calibration uncertainty and its effect on detection risk. The intended output would be uncertainty bounds; work is on hold.
arc-rgbt-P08.nextStep: HOLD: decide whether to activate after the P02 calibration and registration results.
